newsitem.title: UK: AB Foods shares slip as strong stg bites.
newsitem.headline: AB Foods shares slip as strong stg bites.

text.p: Shares in food manufacturer Associated British Foods slid on Monday after the company warned that full year profits might be affected by the strong pound, analysts said.

Shares were down 15 pence by 1019 GMT to 506.5 pence on the day after trading around 520 pence before the announcement, which came with half year results showing pretax profits of 201 million stg, little changed from 198 million stg previously.
"Looking to the full year, results will continue to be affected by the strength of sterling," the company said in a statement.
ABF estimated that the pound's strength had cut into profits for the half year to the tune of 11 million stg.
"First half results were pretty much in line but it was a bit worrying what they said about the strong pound's impact on the second half," one analyst said.
ABF said it would pay an unchanged dividend of 4.25 pence per share.
The group sold its Irish supermarkets to British grocery store chain Tesco Plc last month for 630 million stg. -- London Newsroom +44171 542 7717
